author: Hanz Christensen
title: Apple (AAPL) Given Buy Rating at Macquarie
text:
Tweet
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) ‘s stock had its “buy” rating reaffirmed by equities researchers at Macquarie in a research note issued on Wednesday. They currently have a $214.00 price objective on the iPhone maker’s stock. Macquarie’s price target indicates a potential downside of 5.88% from the company’s current price.
Several other analysts have also commented on the stock. Maxim Group upgraded shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating in a research report on Thursday, May 31st. New Street Research lowered shares of Apple from a “neutral” rating to a “sell” rating in a research report on Monday, August 20th. Loop Capital increased their price target on shares of Apple from $195.00 to $210.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Friday, July 6th. Morgan Stanley reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $232.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, August 22nd. Finally, UBS Group set a $210.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Thursday, June 7th. Two equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating and thirty have assigned a buy rating to the stock. The company has an average rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $232.56. Get Apple alerts:
Shares of AAPL stock traded up $6.30 during trading hours on Wednesday, hitting $227.37. The company’s stock had a trading volume of 1,566,565 shares, compared to its average volume of 28,807,460. The firm has a market capitalization of $1,100.25 billion, a PE ratio of 24.69, a P/E/G ratio of 1.97 and a beta of 1.33. Apple has a twelve month low of $149.16 and a twelve month high of $229.67. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84, a current ratio of 1.31 and a quick ratio of 1.24. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 EPS for the quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. The business had revenue of $53.27 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $52.43 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.98% and a return on equity of 43.50%. The company’s quarterly revenue was up 17.3% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period in the prior year, the business earned $1.67 earnings per share. sell-side analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.74 earnings per share for the current year.
In other news, CEO Timothy D. Cook sold 265,160 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction on Monday, August 27th. The shares were sold at an average price of $217.79, for a total value of $57,749,196.40. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is accessible through this link . Also, insider Angela J. Ahrendts sold 6,568 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction on Friday, June 15th. The shares were sold at an average price of $188.81, for a total transaction of $1,240,104.08. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now directly owns 79,476 shares in the company, valued at approximately $15,005,863.56. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last ninety days, insiders have sold 384,968 shares of company stock worth $82,292,858. 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by insiders.

Delphi Private Advisors LLC now owns 1,175 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $199,000 after buying an additional 1,161 shares during the period. Pineno Levin & Ford Asset Management Inc. increased its stake in Apple by 34.4% during the 4th quarter. Pineno Levin & Ford Asset Management Inc. now owns 7,261 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,229,000 after buying an additional 1,857 shares during the period. SOL Capital Management CO increased its stake in Apple by 3.1% during the 4th quarter. SOL Capital Management CO now owns 34,361 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $5,815,000 after buying an additional 1,034 shares during the period. Wedge Capital Management L L P NC increased its stake in Apple by 15.9% during the 4th quarter. Wedge Capital Management L L P NC now owns 373,155 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $63,149,000 after buying an additional 51,171 shares during the period. Finally, Dividend Assets Capital LLC increased its stake in Apple by 1.4% during the 4th quarter. Dividend Assets Capital LLC now owns 25,254 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,273,000 after buying an additional 360 shares during the period. 58.62% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors and hedge funds.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
